_meta: G6.1 fragment (owner: REAL61). rules.g61_realism: suppression states, fatigue, veterancy, traits. All numbers PROVISIONAL balance fixtures (untuned).

suppression._note: Incoming suppression = base (rules.suppression per_hit / per_near_miss) x weapon factor x target resistance. Weapon factor: weapon def `suppress` field, else class_factor[class] (small_arms with cooldown <= mg_cooldown counts as mg). Resistance multiplies: cover (light = forest / near building or wreck, heavy = garrisoned or a fieldwork cover <= heavy_cover_at), leader nearby, inspiring leader, rank, trait, fatigue. In heavy cover a non-heavy weapon (factor < heavy_weapon_at) cannot push suppression past heavy_cover_cap (below pinned_at): MGs suppress a dug-in squad but do not pin it.

fatigue._note: Level 0..1 per unit (e.fat), updated every update_every ticks. Gain: march_per_tile x tiles moved x load (heavy weapon: weapon class / mg) x assault_mult when on an attack order, plus combat_per_s while under fire. Vehicle crews gain x vehicle_mult. Rest (moved < rest_move tiles, not under fire for rest_after_s): rest_per_s, x garrison_mult in a garrison, x hq_mult within hq_radius of an own home building or medic. Effects above effect_from: speed / accuracy / suppression resistance scale down linearly to (1 - max_*) at 1.0. Exhausted (>= exhausted_at) units do not assault.

veterancy._note: XP: damage_xp per point of damage dealt, kill_xp per kill (+ kill_value_xp per 100 of the victim's cost), combat_xp per second under fire and alive, objective_xp for a sector captured near the unit. Officers / company leaders get officer_share of their company's XP. Ranks at thresholds (green regular veteran elite hero); bonuses per rank index.

traits._note: Leaders (is_officer defs, company leaders) roll leader_count traits at spawn from the world seed and their id (pure function, not stored). Soldiers at veteran+ roll one minor trait. weights = numbers AI levels read through Veterancy.trait_weight(w, uid, key).
